task.title: Atomically save a first consultation message and unique notification outbox
task.input: M4-T8 real necessary cookies, M5 job foundation, and section 09/10 message/conversation/outbox constraints.
task.output: ChatConversation/Message/ReadCursor/Notification schema; POST /api/chat/conversations and durable first-message service.
task.accept: 1) Caller/wiring point: real POST conversations -> cookie-scoped service -> conversation/first message/seq/messageId-unique outbox in one transaction. Return persistent invariant id/seq/receivedAt only after success. Database failure leaves no partial records. The same UUID/payload returns the original result; changed payload returns 409. Concurrency yields one message and one notification (E-18, E-31, E-90). 2) Enforce 16KiB before strict-schema parsing. Body is plain text of 1..4000 code points. Omitted/blank email can send; after trim, over 254 characters, CRLF/display names/invalid format produce field errors. Identity comes from the cookie; another session cannot be associated. Declining analytics still permits receipt without creating an analytics identity (E-39, E-40).
